title: DIAL SDLC Stage Message
description: Sticky JSON payload every SDLC stage writes to stage-output.json at the repo root. Envelope fields (contract_version, run_id, trigger, agent_version) are injected by the composite action — stages do not write them.

contract_version.description: Schema contract version. Injected by the composite action.

agent_version.description: Stage/agent version (semver). Injected by the composite action from the stage workflow's agent_version input.

run_id.description: Correlation ID — the GitHub Actions run ID. Injected by the composite action.

trigger.description: Event context that fired this run. Injected by the composite action.

stage.description: Stage identifier; must match the workflow's stage_name input.

summary.description: One short human-readable line for the sticky PR comment.

spec_id.description: Issue/spec identifier (e.g. "issue-4521") when the stage targets a spec.

spec_version.description: Spec version this stage ran against; used to detect staleness downstream.

requirement_ref.description: Stable spec ID this finding maps to (e.g. "FR-3", "NFR-sec-2").
